单点修改+区间查询，使用树状数组/线段树。 树状数组：1-i的前缀和每次按low.en: Point updates and range queries: use a Fenwick tree or segment tree. In a Fenwick tree, the prefix sum from 1 through i is decomposed into blocks of length lowbit(i) at each step. In a segment tree, each node's interval is repeatedly split into two, storing the corresponding range sums.

连边，所得即为DAG.根据规则，输出最小拓扑排序即可。 考虑优化复杂度，求每个点.en: Add the edges to obtain a DAG, then output the lexicographically smallest topological ordering required by the rules. To improve the complexity, sort and coordinate-compress the values when computing in-degrees, and use a Fenwick tree to track previously scanned heights during a left-to-right sweep. Use a segment tree to optimize range updates to in-degrees during topological sorting: store minimum values, query the root, and binary-search for the interval whose in-degrees need updating.

使用递推公式或使用队列模拟。递推公式为i=(i+m-1)%总人数. 模拟先全部进.en: Use a recurrence or simulate the process with a queue. The recurrence is i = (i + m - 1) % total number of people. For simulation, enqueue everyone, then repeatedly remove an item from the front and return it to the back to form a cycle. Traversing the queue means removing and reinserting its items.

长程 Agent 每轮通常只新增少量内容，却要继续使用很长的历史。当历史 KV.en: Long-horizon agents usually add little content per turn while continuing to use a long history. When historical KV is stored externally, a cache hit avoids recomputation but still requires reading it back. In a cluster with disaggregated prefill and decode, the original data path concentrates storage traffic on prefill machines' network interfaces while those on decode machines may sit idle, leaving GPUs waiting for data.

输入是用户问题、检索或记忆模块提供的 context blocks（上下文块），.en: The inputs are the user's question, context blocks supplied by retrieval or memory modules, and current cache information. The output is a new prompt with aligned, deduplicated blocks and brief annotations, which is passed to the original inference engine.

工具输出扩充后续 prompt，失败可能引发反复诊断与重试。只看工具执行时间，会.en: Tool outputs enlarge subsequent prompts, and failures can trigger repeated diagnosis and retries. Measuring tool execution alone misses the extra inference work it causes afterward. Within active time excluding user idle periods, the paper finds that model calls dominate elapsed time.

这里的 k 决定两次整理之间隔多少步：间隔长可以摊薄摘要更新和重新 Prefil.en: Here, k determines the number of steps between summarization updates. Longer intervals amortize the cost of updating the summary and rerunning prefill, but also lengthen the recent-history buffer. The memory model is specially trained to produce summaries that support the main agent's later decisions, rather than merely making the history short and fluent.

对执行日志先做规则过滤，删去冗长推理等内容；再用轻量模型移除具体名称、数值，形成.en: Rule-based filtering first removes lengthy reasoning and similar content from execution logs. A lightweight model then removes instance-specific names and values to produce keyword–plan-template entries. The system must be able to determine whether an execution is suitable for caching; reliably judging success on open-ended tasks remains a prerequisite for practical deployment.

两两合并n次。两两求前n个的方式是n路归并，即a[0]+b[i],a[1]+b[.en: Merge the sequences pairwise n times. To find the n smallest pair sums, use a multiway merge: the m streams a[0]+b[i], a[1]+b[i], ..., a[m-1]+b[i] compete for the smallest value. Put the first item of each stream in a priority queue; whenever an item is removed, insert the next item from that stream. With heapq, use heapq.heappop() to remove the minimum; a plain pop() removes the last list element.

第三个学期上yhf的课，依旧将复健作为一个学期的开始。自入校以来的几乎每一天，每.en: It is my third semester taking YHF's classes, and once again I am starting the semester by brushing up on my skills. Almost every day since arriving at university, the daily optional problems have stayed on my Chrome to-do list. Most times I open my laptop, one or more unfinished problems are waiting in their tabs. Sometimes I think slowly; sometimes I am too eager for results. I do not always do as well as I would like, but learning a new algorithm still draws me in, and every Accepted verdict makes me genuinely happy. I often feel I am not yet good enough as an AI student. Even if I use vibe coding for other work, I insist on solving every algorithm problem by hand, and I still prefer algorithm courses—an OI contestant at heart, even in college. Of course, I used to feel even less adequate as an OI contestant. But the past matters less now. Doing something tiring yet useful and enjoyable is a good way to spend my time. So I try to enjoy this moment: alone, anywhere, opening my laptop onto a whole world.

After installing the APK, players can start a new save or import a backup through the system file picker, then play independently on the device.

The Android shell serves local assets, opens the file picker, and saves files. Windows, Android, and the web continue to share one gameplay implementation, reducing inconsistencies between platforms.

iPhone / iPad 采用 PWA：在 Safari 打开对应版本，添加到.en: On iPhone and iPad, the game uses a PWA: open the appropriate edition in Safari, add it to the Home Screen, then launch it from that icon to import a save and download all offline resources. This is not an IPA and does not require hosting a Python server; the website serves only static programs and assets, while gameplay and saves remain on the user's device.

Both Windows editions were tested through the sequence “visit animation → information panel → gift after departure → provincial flower claimed → save written to disk.” The mobile local runtime also displayed a visiting frog in Chromium and WebKit. The dedicated visiting-system regression tests and existing state tests passed all 25 checks; personal saves were not modified.

今后的可见交互测试放在新建的独立 Windows 桌面中，避免打断正在做的事情。.en: Future visible interaction tests will run on a newly created, separate Windows desktop to avoid interrupting ongoing work. This round used background commands and a separate headless browser, without opening visible game or emulator windows.

沿着这次串门问题继续检查状态推进的调用点，还确认了几处边界：.en: Following the visiting-system issue through the state-advancement call sites also clarified several remaining limits:

：已有参与、选择、领取和抓取期数的结算，但通用的后续周循环尚未接入。不能因为某一.en: : participation, choices, claiming rewards, and settlement for captured event rounds exist, but a general cycle for later weekends has not yet been integrated. A reward working in one round does not establish that results will be generated correctly every subsequent weekend.

：保留客户端显示相关结构，但没有本地产生新的.en: : the client-side display structures remain, but there is no local process for generating new

内容的流程；个人旅行日记是另一项已实现的替代功能。.en: content. The personal travel diary is a separate alternative feature that has been implemented.

，服务端没有对应的离线排名处理。单机版没有其他真实玩家，不以虚构数据冒充官服排行.en: , but the server has no corresponding offline ranking handler. The single-player edition has no other real players and does not present invented data as an official leaderboard.

旅行、聚会返程、礼品盒旅友、庭院邻居、花圃、花瓶、家具与手工品均有实际运行调用点.en: Travel, returns from gatherings, gift-box travel companions, courtyard neighbors, flowerbeds, vases, furniture, and crafts all have active runtime call sites. Commands once logged as “not implemented” must be checked against the current code; a historical error alone does not prove that the feature is still broken today.

这次补全的是独立庭院串门流程；周末后续期数、漂流瓶新内容和排行榜继续作为明确待办.en: This update completes the separate courtyard-visiting flow. Later weekend event rounds, new message-bottle content, and leaderboards remain explicit TODOs rather than being folded into the same patch.
